hero.title: Support Our Church & Community
hero.description: Together we can strengthen our church, support our community, and continue the work of faith, service, and love.

accounts.title: Available Account Numbers
accounts.description: You can support the church through any of the accounts listed below.
accounts.note: Please verify the account name and number before making a transfer. Contact the church if you need additional payment information.

volunteer.title: Volunteer Activities
volunteer.description: Your time, skills, and willingness to serve can make a meaningful difference.

items.title: Church Service
items.description: Help with church activities, welcoming visitors, organizing events, and supporting the daily needs of the church.

items.title: Sunday School
items.description: Support children and young people through teaching, mentoring, educational activities, and spiritual guidance.

items.title: Community Support
items.description: Take part in activities that support families, elderly people, children, and members of our wider community.

items.title: Media & Technology
items.description: Help with photography, video, livestreaming, social media, website updates, and other digital activities.

ways.title: Other Ways You Can Support
ways.description: There are many ways to contribute to the life and mission of our church.

items.title: Prayer
items.description: Pray for the church, its members, families, leaders, children, and all the work being carried out in the community.

items.title: Financial Support
items.description: Your financial contribution helps the church continue its spiritual, educational, charitable, and community activities.

items.title: Community Service
items.description: Give your time and skills to help people in need and strengthen our church and community.

cta.title: Every contribution makes a difference.
cta.description: Thank you for supporting our church and helping us serve our community.
